Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production background key art for the completed-victory screen of a PC Journey to the West dark-fantasy strategy game, widescreen 16:9, high-resolution landscape illustration.
Primary request: paint the 'return to the mortal world after breaking the Black Lotus' victorious ending in the established black-stone and antique-gold temple art direction. A mature heroic Sun Wukong, recognizable monkey face and brown fur, wearing weathered black and bronze-gold Chinese armor, muted crimson scarf, and carrying the Ruyi golden staff, walks calmly out of an ancient Chinese Buddhist temple toward the first warm dawn. Victory is quiet, compassionate and earned; no combat pose. The temple's black-lotus corruption is fading into a few golden motes, not an explosion.
Composition/framing: one continuous environment, cinematic wide shot. Sun Wukong is a full-body three-quarter back view in the right third, grounded on broad worn stone steps; the golden dawn and an open ancient temple doorway sit behind him toward the upper right. The LEFT 44 percent remains dark, calm, softly textured stone and mist with low detail because actual live Chinese title, short copy and menu buttons will be placed there by the game. Leave the lower left dark and unobstructed too. Character stays within the center-right safe area so a narrower PC window can crop to that side.
Style/medium: premium hand-painted game ending key art with realistic materials and sculptural silhouette, black lacquer, carved aged bronze, restrained gold leaf; architectural elements share perspective, lighting and contact shadows. Monumental but not cluttered.
Lighting/mood: black jade shadows, soft warm ivory sunrise, subdued cinnabar accent, hopeful after a difficult journey. The character and exit are the focal point; background architecture is subordinate.
Text: absolutely NO text, letters, calligraphy, numbers, UI, borders, logos, watermarks or baked-in buttons. This is the finished illustration that will sit behind real HTML controls, not a screenshot or mockup.
Avoid: extra characters, duplicate Wukongs, floating characters or props, huge magic rings, ornamental rectangular panels, portrait collages, piles of relic icons, game HUD, modern website advertisement styling, over-saturation, heavy blur. Create a single polished, usable game background.
